cat kit/policy-templates.md; echo ---; ls -la kit out
cd .claude/skills/xano-policies && grep -n "^#" SKILL.md; grep -n -i "train\|member\|team\|staff\|employee\|attest\|honest" SKILL.md | head -60

grep -o -i "[^\"]\{0,80\}train[^\"]\{0,80\}" kit/catalogue.json | head; echo "---pull"; xano workspace pull -d ./workspace 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "---"; ls ./workspace 2>/dev/null; grep -ril "tag" ./workspace 2>/dev/null | head -20
ls workspace/table workspace/api/* | head -60; grep -l "tags" workspace/table/* 2>/dev/null | head; grep -h "tags" workspace/table/* 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head
grep -ril "train" workspace | head; echo "---"; sed -n '1,30p' workspace/table/users.xs; echo ---; sed -n '1,12p' workspace/table/clinical_notes.xs; echo ---; xano policy list 2>&1 | head -20

mkdir -p out && cat > out/reply.md <<'EOF'
I can't set up a policy that enforces this one, and I didn't write a policy file, because a policy would not actually check what you asked.

final_message: Wrote `out/reply.md` and `out/notes.json`; no `.xs` policy file, because no check can verify training completion and the workspace has no training data. Confidence that the policy can't achieve the goal: high.
